Thanks Aditya — looping in Legal to own the review. Elaine / Primex team, quick checklist from our side so we can triage redlines faster:  

1) Counterparty legal name and corporate form (exact as will appear on signature page)
2) Authorized signatory name, title, and email
3) Primary billing contact and PO process (if any)
4) Insurance limits and current carrier — please attach certificate if available
5) Data residency and retention constraints (any EU/other residency requirements?)
6) Security evidence links (SOC 2 report, pen test summary) or where we can pull them
7) SSO/SCIM or SAML requirement and any KMS/HSM obligations for customer-managed keys
8) Any proposed changes to Redwood’s standard IP or indemnity language we should expect

If Primex can send the redline on the MSA and a populated Order Form, we will aim to complete an initial review within 48–72 hours. If clauses look non-standard (IP carveouts, long-tail indemnities), we’ll escalate to counsel and update timeline.

I’ve attached a short redline playbook (section called "Intake Triage") to show how we classify high/medium/low risk items. Also please indicate who will be the DocuSign sender.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

--
